name: Haruka
source:
Eldest of the twins, Haruka enjoys the peaceful and quiet moments of life, such as reading books or planting flowers. She is an outstanding home keeper, and truly enjoys the role of being a stereotypical housewife. Between the sisters, Haruka presents herself as the most patient and mature spouse.

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175448/www.elizar.com/?p=29]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
